A selected building must be constructed first. Note that the previously constructed building remains after the new one is built. The effects entered below are then added together.
The user's premium account is charged in addition to the club account.
Additional strength points in fitness and satisfaction that can be gained per training session.
Strength bonus for discovered youth players.
Percentage points of additional tickets sold at home matches. The bonus is lost if no tickets would be sold without the building bonus.
One-time change in the user's fan popularity in percentage points. The effect is credited only after construction is completed.
Number of additional matches by which player injuries are reduced after each match, in addition to normal recovery. Example: value 1 halves recovery time.
The amount is credited to the club at each home match if positive, or debited if negative.
Percentage bonus to merchandising demand at home matches.
